findings.evidence: SystemInfoInitializer.kt:14 reads Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID and line 20 passes it to logger.log(). The only Logger implementation (LoggerImpl.kt:14-23) keeps entries in an in-memory MutableSharedFlow (replay = 100) and has no network or file output; core/logger/app-logger/build.gradle.kts depends only on core modules. The three consumers of getLogFlow() are all on-device: DrawerFragment.kt:231 (on-screen RecyclerView log), CameraFragment.kt:100 (Log.d to Logcat) and XoViewModel.kt:44 (UI state). No off-device sink was found. VPNDetector.kt is a false positive for this data type: TelephonyManager is used only for dataNetworkType (line 56), a network class rather than an identifier, and the class has no callers in app, core or feature. No IMEI, advertising ID or Build.SERIAL reads exist in the app, core or feature sources. The version catalog and Gradle files contain no Firebase, Crashlytics, Sentry, AppMetrica or ad SDKs; the only Play services dependencies are play-services-instantapps and core-performance-play-services (DevicePerformanceInitializer.kt:12 logs only the media performance class), and the app manifest declares no AD_ID permission.
findings.recommendation: No Data Safety declaration is required for this data. Optional clean-up: stop reading and logging ANDROID_ID in SystemInfoInitializer.kt, because it is shown in the drawer log and written to Logcat with no functional use, and any future Logger sink would start sending it off-device. VPNDetector.kt is unused and can be deleted.

findings.evidence: False positive. The three layouts declare a WebView (activity_dotabuff.xml:2, activity_log.xml:2, activity_news.xml:29), but nothing references them: there is no R.layout usage or generated binding usage in the app, core or feature Kotlin sources. No Kotlin or Java source instantiates a WebView or calls loadUrl, evaluateJavascript or addJavascriptInterface; the only Kotlin match for WebView is a comment in feature/news/domain/api/.../Article.kt stating that articles are drawn natively. These are the only layouts with a WebView, so the app has no code path that records or sends visited websites.
findings.recommendation: No Data Safety declaration is required for this data. Delete the three unused layouts so that this false positive does not recur in later audits.

findings.evidence: CrashHandlerInitializer.kt:19-25 handles uncaughtException by passing exception.toString() to logger.log() and then delegating to the default handler. The stack trace built on lines 20-21 is never used. LoggerImpl.kt:14-23 holds entries only in an in-memory SharedFlow, which is lost when the process dies, and its consumers are on-device only (drawer log, Logcat, XO UI state). HistoricalProcessExitReasonsInitializer.kt:25-31 logs the exit reason and description to the same logger and sends nothing else anywhere. No crash-reporting SDK is present in the version catalog or Gradle files; Yandex AppMetrica, which sent crash reports before, has been removed. No off-device sink was found.
findings.recommendation: No Data Safety declaration is required for this data. Optional clean-up: remove the unused StringWriter/printStackTrace in CrashHandlerInitializer.kt:20-21 and the unused trace read in HistoricalProcessExitReasonsInitializer.kt:29-30. Worth double-checking: the license screen text license_text16 (feature/settings strings.xml:26, shown by fragment_license.xml:89) says the provider may collect technical data about the device, which does not match an app that collects nothing; consider aligning that text with the Data Safety form. Any future crash reporter requires updating the form first.
